design.variance: Taylor linearization, with replacement at the first stage; no finite population correction

fair_poor.label: Fair or poor self-rated health
fair_poor.universe: Sample adults aged 18 years or older
fair_poor.denominator_note: Use valid responses for this outcome within the requested population. Refused, not ascertained, unknown, blank and system-missing responses are excluded, not coded as absence of the event.
fair_poor.system_missing_policy: Exclude blank or system-missing values; never recode them to zero.
fair_poor.event: reporting fair or poor self-rated health
fair_poor.definition: For Sample Adults aged 18 years or older, this event is a report of fair or poor general health at the time of interview.
fair_poor.limitation: Self-rated health is a subjective general-health measure, not a clinical diagnosis or a measure of health insurance or access to medical care.

HICOV_A.label: Initial report of health insurance coverage
HICOV_A.definition: The initial question records whether any health insurance or other health care plan is reported before the insurance-section editing process.
HICOV_A.universe: Sample adults aged 18 years or older
HICOV_A.limitation: The codebook warns that this initial item does not incorporate insurance-section editing. It is not substituted for the edited NOTCOV_A coverage classification.

insured.limitation: Coverage is measured at interview, not throughout the past year. Insurance coverage does not establish that needed care was obtained promptly.
insured.source_note: The edited coverage definition includes private insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, CHIP, state-sponsored or other government plans, and military coverage including TRICARE, VA and CHAMP-VA. The initial HICOV_A response is not used as a substitute.

delayed_care_cost.universe: Sample adults aged 18 years or older
delayed_care_cost.denominator_note: Use valid responses for this outcome within the requested population. Refused, not ascertained, unknown, blank and system-missing responses are excluded, not coded as absence of the event.
delayed_care_cost.system_missing_policy: Exclude blank or system-missing values; never recode them to zero.
delayed_care_cost.label: Delayed medical care because of cost (past 12 months)
delayed_care_cost.event: delaying medical care because of cost during the past 12 months
delayed_care_cost.definition: For Sample Adults aged 18 years or older, this event is reporting a delay in getting medical care because of cost during the past 12 months.
delayed_care_cost.limitation: This item measures cost-related delays only. A no response does not establish timely care or absence of other barriers; its complement is not an all-cause timely-care measure.

unmet_care_cost.label: Needed medical care but did not get it because of cost (past 12 months)
unmet_care_cost.event: needing medical care but not getting it because of cost during the past 12 months
unmet_care_cost.definition: For Sample Adults aged 18 years or older, this event is needing medical care but not obtaining it because of cost during the past 12 months.
unmet_care_cost.limitation: This item measures unmet need because of cost only. Its denominator is all valid respondents in the target population, not only people reporting a need for care. A no response does not establish that all needed care was obtained promptly.

reliability.policy_note: Conservative application reliability gates; not a complete implementation or certification of NCHS data presentation standards. Suppressed cells return null estimates and intervals.

regression.full_formula: fair_poor ~ education + age + sex + race + income

confidence_intervals.proportions: Design-based t-Wald interval: svymean plus/minus t critical value times Taylor standard error; cell-domain degrees of freedom
confidence_intervals.multiply_imputed: Rubin pooled mean and total variance; finite complete-data cell-domain df with Barnard-Rubin adjusted t df
confidence_intervals.invalid_bounds_policy: Suppress; never silently clip intervals to [0,1]
confidence_intervals.regression: Pool log-odds and covariance matrices; t confidence limits transformed to odds-ratio scale

validation.note: Tolerances are preregistered acceptance thresholds, not evidence of agreement. No numerical R/Stata parity has been verified.
